heading, The Adora Digital Platform supports women through every stage of their peri/menopause journey., level 3
The Adora Digital Platform supports women through every stage of their peri/menopause journey.
end of heading, The Adora Digital Platform supports women through every stage of their peri/menopause journey., level 3

From completing the menopause stage assessment and receiving a personalised care plan, to accessing our specialist nurse team for expert guidance — Adora is designed to be a comprehensive, evidence-based resource.

Users can track symptoms, book one-to-one appointments with gynaecologists for faster diagnosis and treatment, and easily share health reports with their GP. The platform also offers expert-led content, live webinars, and a supportive community space where women can connect and share their experiences.
